import collections
import text

queries := [
    "name=Alice+Smith&age=30&city=New%20York",
    "q=c%2B%2B+tutorial&page=2&sort=desc&page=3",
    "msg=50%25+off%21&debug&lang=en&ref=&lang=ja",
    "redirect=https%3a%2f%2fexample.com%2Fhome&token=abc==&item10=pen&item2=fish%26chips",
]
for: query := queries[index]
    map<string, string[]> decoded
    for item := query.split("&")[]
        raw_key := item
        raw_value := ""
        match item.find("=")
            nat separator
                raw_key = item[:<separator]
                raw_value = item[(separator + 1):]
            none
                raw_value = ""
        key := text.url.query.decode_form_component(raw_key)
        value := text.url.query.decode_form_component(raw_value)
        match decoded.get(key)
            string[] existing
                .decoded.set(key, existing.append(value))
            none
                .decoded.set(key, [value])
    entries := collections.sorted_entries(decoded)
    println("query {index + 1}:")
    for (key, values) := entries[]
        quoted := [for value := values[] then DQ + value + DQ]
        println("  {key}: {quoted.join(", ")}")
